description: This file defines the class WifiDirectShareTransport, which implements peer discovery, connection, and file transfer via Wi-Fi Direct (Wi-Fi P2P) in an Android application. It manages system services, permissions, and socket communication to facilitate peer-to-peer file sharing.

classes.name: WifiDirectShareTransport
classes.description: Handles Wi-Fi Direct peer discovery, connection, and file transfer operations.

classes.name: WifiDirectPeerSession
classes.description: Represents a Wi-Fi Direct peer session, manages socket connection and file transfer pipes.

methods.name: startDiscovery
methods.description: Starts peer discovery process, manages UI for peer selection, and handles connection setup.

methods.name: sendFile
methods.description: Establishes socket connection to the peer and streams a file identified by a URI with progress callback.
